meta.title: MECCF Priority Indicators – GGA Crosswalk
meta.subtitle: Kenya Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry (MECCF) national/county priority indicators, linked to the UNFCCC Global Goal on Adaptation (GGA) 59-indicator framework

sources.label: MECCF Priority Indicators
sources.description: Kenya's national climate change adaptation and mitigation indicators, defined by the Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry for the 2026 reporting cycle. Includes county-level roll-ups.

sources.label: Global Goal on Adaptation (59 Indicators)
sources.description: The UNFCCC's global adaptation indicator framework (UAE Framework for Global Climate Resilience, adopted COP28), spanning 11 thematic and dimensional targets.

sources.label: FGD & Household Survey Indicators
sources.description: Community-level indicators to be derived from Focus Group Discussions (FGDs) and Household (HH) surveys, refining and grounding the national indicators in lived experience.

meta.methodologyNote: Each indicator set is retained in its original, distinct form so that provenance stays traceable back to its source (MECCF, GGA, or future FGD/HH data). A harmonized view sits on top, showing where MECCF's priority indicators map onto GGA's global framework — without collapsing or replacing the underlying source data. This dual structure keeps the methodology auditable as FGD/HH-derived indicators are added.

meccfIndicators.name: Percentage of Compliant Meteorological Stations Meeting World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Standards
meccfIndicators.numerator: Number of operational meteorological stations in the official KMD National Meteorological Station Inventory assessed during the reporting period and found compliant with applicable WMO standards.
meccfIndicators.denominator: Total number of operational meteorological stations listed in the official KMD National Meteorological Station Inventory during the reporting period.

links.note: Both track the establishment/quality of monitoring infrastructure used for hazard forecasting.
WMO-compliant stations are a precondition for the climate information services this GGA indicator tracks.

meccfIndicators.plainSummary: In plain terms: what share of Kenya's weather stations meet the international quality standard for reliable forecasts and warnings.

meccfIndicators.name: Number of Multihazard Early Warning Bulletins Produced
meccfIndicators.thematicArea: Climate Change Adaptation (Early Warning / Disaster Risk Reduction)
meccfIndicators.numerator: Number of officially approved multihazard early warning bulletins issued by KMD during the reporting period.

links.note: Bulletin production is a direct output of an established multi-hazard early warning system.
Bulletins are the mechanism by which population coverage under this indicator is achieved.

meccfIndicators.plainSummary: In plain terms: how many official alerts the Kenya Meteorological Department issues to warn people about floods, droughts, storms and other hazards.

meccfIndicators.name: Amount of Climate Finance Disbursed (United States Dollars (USD)
meccfIndicators.numerator: Total amount (USD) of climate finance disbursed during the reporting period for eligible climate actions across Kenya.

links.note: Both track finance disbursed/received for adaptation implementation.

meccfIndicators.plainSummary: In plain terms: how much money (in US dollars) was actually spent on climate action during the reporting period.

meccfIndicators.name: Number of counties with operational Climate Information Services (CIS)
meccfIndicators.thematicArea: Climate Change Adaptation and Climate Information Services
meccfIndicators.numerator: Number of counties whose Climate Information Service satisfies all nationally approved minimum operational functionality criteria during the reporting period.

links.note: County CIS operationalization is Kenya's sub-national tracking of this GGA target.

meccfIndicators.plainSummary: In plain terms: how many of Kenya's 47 counties have a fully working local climate information service that residents can rely on.

meccfIndicators.name: Number of counties that have established institutional frameworks for climate change knowledge management
meccfIndicators.numerator: Number of counties whose institutional frameworks satisfy all nationally approved minimum operational standards for climate change knowledge management.

links.note: Knowledge management frameworks are a building block for a functioning MEL system.
County-level institutional frameworks feed into national MEL operationalization.

meccfIndicators.plainSummary: In plain terms: how many counties have a proper system in place for organising, storing and sharing climate knowledge.

meccfIndicators.name: Number of counties that have established operational multi-hazard early warning systems (EWS)
meccfIndicators.numerator: Number of counties with operational multi-hazard early warning systems meeting all nationally approved minimum operational standards.

links.note: County-level tracking of the same multi-hazard EWS establishment target.

meccfIndicators.plainSummary: In plain terms: how many counties have a working system that warns residents before a disaster strikes.

meccfIndicators.name: Number of counties that have conducted validated climate risk and vulnerability assessments
meccfIndicators.numerator: Number of counties with completed and validated climate risk and vulnerability assessment reports meeting nationally approved standards.
meccfIndicators.denominator: Total number of counties in Kenya (47).

links.note: Both track completion of climate hazard, impact and vulnerability assessments.

meccfIndicators.plainSummary: In plain terms: how many counties have completed an approved study of their climate risks and who is most vulnerable to them.

meccfIndicators.name: Total greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions abated against the Business-as-Usual (BAU) scenario
meccfIndicators.numerator: Total greenhouse gas emissions reduced (MtCO₂e) relative to the approved BAU emissions projection for the reporting year.
meccfIndicators.unit: Million tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (MtCO₂e).
meccfIndicators.scopeNote: The GGA's 59 indicators cover adaptation only; this is a mitigation indicator (tracked separately, e.g. against Kenya's NDC mitigation targets) and has no direct GGA counterpart.
meccfIndicators.plainSummary: In plain terms: how much Kenya has cut its greenhouse gas emissions compared to what they would have been without climate action.

meccfIndicators.name: Number of state and non-state actors that have submitted climate change reports
meccfIndicators.numerator: Number of eligible state and non-state actors that submitted climate change reports during the reporting period.
meccfIndicators.denominator: Total number of eligible state and non-state actors required to submit climate change reports during the reporting period.
meccfIndicators.unit: Number (with reporting coverage expressed as a percentage where applicable).

links.note: Both track periodic publication/submission of adaptation-related reporting.
Reporting compliance is one proxy for how well national adaptation plans are being implemented.

meccfIndicators.plainSummary: In plain terms: how many government bodies, companies and organisations submitted the climate reports they are required to file.

Proportion of critical water and sanitation infrastructure systems that are resilient to climate-related hazards under different warming scenarios, as appropriate for regions and contexts, including as an outcome of adaptation actions where applicable

Proportion of the total area of basins and cryosphere for which a climate adaptation plan has been developed and implemented on the basis of different warming scenarios, as appropriate for regions and contexts where applicable

Proportion of bodies of water with good ambient water quality for drinking water supply, including as an outcome of adaptation actions where applicable
Number of people per 100,000 supported in planned relocation processes in response to water-related hazards, where adaptation measures were taken to ensure safety of populations
Proportion of area under management for food and agricultural production utilizing practices and technologies relevant to climate change adaptation

Extent of implementation of institutional frameworks for knowledge transfer, research and development (R&D), and extension services supporting climate change adaptation in the areas of food and agriculture relative to needs
Level of degraded areas that are under management for food and agricultural production, including as an outcome of adaptation actions where applicable

Level of resilience of ecosystems, including as an outcome of adaptation actions where applicable

Number of people per 100,000 that are covered by early warning information through local governments or through national dissemination mechanisms
Percentage of the population in a country exposed to or at risk from climate-related disasters protected through pre-emptive evacuation measures following early warning
Level of establishment of climate information services for risk reduction and systematic observation to support improved climate-related data, information and services
